name: select_m16_nut_from_covered_tray
instruction: pick the larger M16 nut instead of the M8 nut from the covered tray, judging size by touch

name: select_golf_ball_by_touch_in_bin
instruction: retrieve the dimpled golf ball rather than the smooth ball from the covered bin using touch

name: retrieve_toothed_service_token_from_toolbox
instruction: Explore the covered compartment tray by touch, find the service token with the sawtooth edge, and place it on the rubber service mat.

name: select_horizontal_ribbed_cap_by_touch
instruction: Among the caps in the covered recycling tray, find the cap with horizontal ribs—not vertical ribs—and place it in the recycle cup.

name: select_golf_ball_by_touch
instruction: Explore the two balls by touch, identify the dimpled golf ball rather than the smooth table-tennis ball, and place it in the left cup.

name: select_cylinder_with_most_circumferential_threads
instruction: Among the six equal-size cylinders in the open parts box, find the one with the most circumferential threads and place it on the inspection tray.

name: select_wave_service_token
instruction: Among the tokens in the covered compartment tray, find the one with the wave-shaped edge and place it on the rubber service mat.

name: select_horizontal_ribbed_cap_into_bowl
instruction: Among the three caps on the table, use touch to find the cap with horizontal ribs and place it in the bowl.

name: tactile_peg_reorientation
instruction: pick up the horizontal rectangular peg from the box bottom, lift it vertically, and insert it

name: tactile_object_search
instruction: find and retrieve the target object from the box using tactile feedback

name: tactile_ball_sorting
instruction: distinguish the golf ball from the table tennis ball by touch and lift the golf ball

name: insert_the_held_power_plug_into_the_moving_socket
instruction: Insert the three-prong power plug already held by the gripper into the power socket on the moving conveyor platform

name: insert_the_held_bulb_into_the_moving_socket
instruction: Insert the bulb already held by the gripper into the bulb socket on the moving conveyor platform

name: insert_the_held_usb_plug_into_the_moving_socket

name: pick_table_tube_and_insert_into_moving_fixture

name: pick_tube_from_moving_source_and_insert_into_table_fixture
instruction: Pick the test tube from the moving source base and insert it into the angled hole base on the table

name: pick_table_key_and_insert_into_moving_fixture
instruction: Pick the key from the table and insert it into the target lock mounted on the conveyor platform

name: pick_key_from_moving_source_and_insert_into_table_fixture
instruction: Pick the key from the moving source lock and insert it into the target lock on the table

name: pick_table_hdmi_and_insert_into_moving_fixture
instruction: Pick the HDMI connector from the table and insert it into the HDMI slot mounted on the conveyor platform

name: pick_hdmi_from_moving_source_and_insert_into_table_fixture
instruction: Pick the HDMI connector and insert it into the HDMI slot on the table

name: pick_table_gear_and_insert_into_moving_fixture
instruction: Pick the gear from the table and press it into the gear base mounted on the conveyor platform

name: pick_gear_from_moving_source_and_insert_into_table_fixture
instruction: Pick the gear and press it into the gear base on the table

name: pull_drawer
instruction: Pull the drawer open by at least 12 cm.

name: open_hinged_door
instruction: Grasp the handle and open the hinged door by at least 60 degrees.

name: turn_valve
instruction: Turn the valve counterclockwise by 90 degrees relative to its initial angle.

name: press_spring_button
instruction: Press the spring button at least 8 mm for 0.3 seconds, then release it.

name: toggle_bistable_switch
instruction: Move the bistable lever from the negative well to the positive well, then let go.

name: remove_friction_cap
instruction: Pull the cap completely out of its spring-loaded retaining shoes and move it away by at least 3 cm.

name: follow_rigid_contour
instruction: Follow the thin sinusoidal rail from its left end to its right end while maintaining tactile contact.

name: table_supported_pivot
instruction: Pivot the block upright by 90 degrees while keeping it supported by the table and allowing rotation within the gripper.

name: slice_banana
instruction: Use the knife held in the gripper to cut the banana at its middle scored plane, and lift the blade clear while leaving both portions on the board.

name: slice_cucumber
instruction: Use the knife held in the gripper to cut the cucumber at its middle scored plane, and lift the blade clear while leaving both portions on the board.

name: push_block_along_s_curve
instruction: Push the block along the complete S-shaped path while maintaining tactile and tabletop contact.

name: roll_can_half_turn
instruction: Roll the can through half a turn along the table without sliding or lifting it.

name: drive_passive_gear_transmission
instruction: Turn the medium gear by ninety degrees so that both passive output gears rotate through their required angles.

name: hang_mug_by_handle
instruction: Lift the mug, thread its handle over the hook, lower it, and release it so that the hook supports its weight.

name: arrest_gravity_driven_axial_slip
instruction: Lift the rod, hold the hand still, allow a twenty millimeter downward slip, then tighten the fingers to arrest it without regrasping.

name: stand_rod_on_table
instruction: Pick up the horizontal rod near its center, orient it upright, place its flat end beside the cradle, then release and retreat while it stands unsupported.

name: press_then_slide_latch
instruction: Grasp the raised latch grip, depress its spring-loaded lug below the keeper, slide it clear along the rail, then release and retreat while the plunger returns.

name: inspect_and_localize_raised_defect
instruction: Briefly touch each of the three inspection coupons, lifting clear between probes. Then indicate the raised defect with a steady final gel contact.

name: reseat_keyed_ram_module
instruction: Withdraw the RAM module at least 2 cm, reinsert its keyed edge, then release it and retreat.

name: wipe_bottle
instruction: Grasp the cloth-wrapped sponge, wipe the dirt from the floral porcelain vase secured in its cradle, then lift the sponge clear.

name: wipe_whiteboard
instruction: Grasp the felt eraser, erase the TacMind lettering from the rectangular whiteboard, then lift the eraser clear.

name: assembly_bulb
instruction: Grasp the light bulb and screw it fully into the socket.

name: assembly_nut_thread
instruction: Grasp the nut and thread it fully onto the bolt.
